about.title: About LTD Tax Services & Business Solutions
text: LTD Tax Services has the expertise you need to resolve the most difficult tax issues. Whether you need help with your personal return or your business, we have years of experience you can rely on.

With over ten years of industry experience, LTD Tax Services has the expertise you need to solve even the most difficult tax-related problems. Whether you need assistance with a tax return, forming a business, credit restoration, or tax resolution, we have experts on staff who are qualified to speak to the IRS directly on your behalf.
We look for every deduction to get you the maximum refund permitted by law. We can service all 50 states.
